title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment: Storage Days Beyond the Approved End Date
content:
The carrier pays storage only through the approved storage end date. **For the closing payment on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job, the closing payment carries the job's most recent vault, climate vault and oversized item storage lines billed to the insurance claim, taken together, times the unpaid storage days, divided by the tier's period length; the unpaid storage days are counted from the day after a cut-off date through the last day of the storage period that contains that date, and the storage extension request read is the one for this job that asks for the latest end date; when the approved storage end date falls before today and before the last day of its storage period and that request asks for an end date later than the approved storage end date and inside the same period, the cut-off is the requested end date; when the approved storage end date falls before today and before the last day of its storage period and no request for this job asks for an end date later than the approved storage end date, the cut-off is the approved storage end date; in every other case there are no unpaid storage days.**

Storage periods are counted in whole periods of the tier's period length from the custody start date. The approved storage end date and the storage extension requests for this job are read from the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file; the storage lines are the job's most recent insurance-billed vault, climate vault and oversized item lines, by the first day of their period.

## Input – judgement – days

1. Is the approved storage end date before today and before the last day of the storage period containing it? If not, there are no unpaid storage days.
2. If so, does the request for this job asking the latest end date ask for a later date inside that same period? Then the cut-off is the requested date.
3. If no request for this job asks for a later date, the cut-off is the approved date.
4. A request asking for a later date outside that period leaves no unpaid storage days.

## Cases (hypothetical: 30-day periods, custody from 10 August, a period running 9 September to 8 October)

- Approved end 25 September, no later request: 26 September through 8 October, 13 days.
- Approved end 25 September, request asking 3 October: 4 October through 8 October, 5 days.
- Insurance-billed most recent lines of 150.00 (climate vault) and 90.00 (oversized item): 13 days carry 240.00 times 13 divided by 30, or 104.00.
